project_type: 4A Store v2 — Express/TypeScript API (api-node) + Vite/React SPA (web), MySQL/MariaDB via Prisma. Served Cloudflare -> Apache (SPA at /var/www/html) with /api reverse-proxied to the Node app (pm2 on 127.0.0.1:4000).
build_system: api-node: tsc (`npm run build` = `tsc -p tsconfig.json`). web: Vite (`npm run build`). Prisma client is NOT committed; it must be generated. In this worktree node_modules is NOT installed and the Prisma client is absent — run `npm install` first.
test_framework: No unit test runner is configured in api-node or web (package.json has no test script). Verification is `npm run build` (both) + `npx prisma validate` (api-node) + documented post-deploy curl checks.
build_command: api-node: `npm run build`  |  web: `npm run build`
test_command: api-node: `npx prisma validate` + `npm run build`  |  web: `npm run build`  (no separate test suite exists)
verification_instructions: 1) In api-node and web run `npm install`. 2) In api-node run `npx prisma generate`; if the engine download is BLOCKED, copy `c:\xampp\htdocs\static4a\4astore-v2\api-node\node_modules\.prisma` and `...\node_modules\@prisma\client` from the MAIN checkout into the worktree api-node node_modules (schema is identical) and note the fallback. 3) `npx prisma validate` must pass. 4) `npm run build` must pass in api-node AND web. 5) Post-deploy (cannot run in worktree, document only): `curl -A 'WhatsApp/2.0' https://4astore.com/link/<code> | grep og:image` shows the product image; `curl -A 'Mozilla/5.0' https://4astore.com/link/<code>` returns the smart-redirect HTML; a desktop browser hitting /link/<code> lands on the website product page.
snapshot_or_generated_files: Prisma client (node_modules/.prisma, node_modules/@prisma/client) is generated, not committed. If a Prisma MODEL is added, the main checkout must run `npx prisma generate` after merge. web/public/sitemap.xml is generated by `node scripts/generate-sitemap.mjs` (unrelated to this task). No test snapshots.
environment_constraints: Worktree root is c:\xampp\htdocs\static4a\.worktrees\smart-shortlink\4astore-v2 — relative paths in a shell resolve to the PARENT workspace, so ALWAYS use absolute worktree paths. Prisma engine download may be blocked in the worktree (TLS); copy the generated client from the main checkout as a fallback. Apache `configtest` and live curl checks cannot run in the worktree — treat them as post-deploy. Do NOT touch legacy 4AStoreApp/PHP. Do NOT rebuild the mobile app.
contribution_requirements: Follow the repo's NO-MIGRATE DB convention: additive, idempotent, information_schema-guarded raw SQL via prisma.$executeRawUnsafe (see ensureNotificationTables/ensureMarketingTables/ensureMasterPasswordColumn in services/dataImport.ts, and the manual-run prisma/*.sql files like catalog-version.sql). Never run `prisma migrate`/`db push`. New Prisma models get an @@map and a manual prisma/<name>.sql equivalent. Reuse the ONE OG source of truth (services/ogShare.ts) — never fork OG logic. Commit locally on the `smart-shortlink` branch; never push.
key_patterns: Admin routes gate with `requireAuth, requireStaff('<perm>')` (routes/marketing.ts uses `router.use(requireAuth, requireStaff('ads'))`). Product create is `POST /api/admin/products` body `{action:'add'|'update'|'delete', product}` in routes/admin.ts; after create it calls `bumpCatalogVersion()` and fire-and-forget `void runProductSeo(id).catch(()=>undefined)` — mirror that for short-link auto-create. Startup `ensure*` calls live in server.ts inside `app.listen(...)` with `.catch(e=>console.error(...))`. OG builders in services/ogShare.ts return `{html}` or `{notFound:true}`; crawler detector `isCrawler(ua)` + handler in middleware/ogCrawler.ts. Origins: SITE_ORIGIN/API_ORIGIN from seo/origin.ts (https://4astore.com, .../api). Web client wraps axios `api` from web/src/lib/api.ts, functions return `(await api.get/post(...)).data`. Admin pages live under web/src/pages/admin and are routed in web/src/App.tsx under `<Route path='/admin' element={<AdminApp/>}>`.
